public.title: Combination Sum
public.description: candidates contains 0 to 12 distinct integers from 1 to 40. Return all combinations that sum to integer target from 0 to 20, using each candidate any number of times. Sort each combination increasingly and sort the result lexicographically by numeric values; a proper prefix comes first. Do not duplicate combinations. target zero returns [[]].
hints: Reusing the same candidate means recursing from its current index.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Backtracking selects nondecreasing candidate sequences and stops at target zero. Time is output-sensitive and exponential in target/minimum candidate; O(target/minimum candidate) path space plus output.
